definition: the things that arrived on time during our five-day engagement

settled:
Omens are one of the ways I get revelation: the right thing at the right time, with a precision that does not match probability.

Despite the five-day engagement we had a ring, gifted by my paternal grandfather, and a temple wedding, with my maternal grandfather getting permission from the church's First Presidency to officiate.

After four fruitless hours of apartment-hunting, a man in a blood-donation line overheard Jen's roommates, turned around, and offered us his mother's basement at a price that was almost nothing.

Every one of those five days brought new miracles.

title: The Miracles In Those Five Days
